dataset_description: Dealer-level aftersales category sales performance across the latest three reporting months, including category-wise sales values and identification of categories exhibiting sustained month-over-month decline patterns.

decline_comparison_logic: Latest reporting month compared with middle reporting month
Middle reporting month compared with oldest reporting month
Oldest reporting month compared with Current Date - 5 Months

ComfortSafetyAccessories.description: Sales values for Comfort and Safety Accessories across oldest, middle and latest reporting months.
ComfortSafetyAccessories.format: Oldest Month Sales, Middle Month Sales, Latest Month Sales

TransportSolutionsAccessories.description: Sales values for Transport Solutions Accessories across oldest, middle and latest reporting months.

Categories_With_Decline_Pct.description: List of categories that declined in at least two month-over-month comparisons.

decline_definition.condition: Current Month Sales < Previous Month Sales

decline_threshold.condition: Category must decline in at least 2 out of 3 available decline comparisons.

average_decline_percentage.formula: Average percentage decline across all decline occurrences.

trend_analysis_logic.latest_month_priority: Always prioritize latest reporting month sales performance.

stable_category.meaning: Category does not meet sustained decline criteria.

high_risk_category.meaning: Category requires dealer discussion and investigation.

multiple_declining_categories.condition: More than 3 categories appear in Categories_With_Decline_Pct
multiple_declining_categories.meaning: Dealer exhibits broad-based decline across multiple categories.

talking_point_generation.maintenance_decline: Maintenance category shows sustained sales decline and may require dealer discussion regarding servicing demand and ordering behaviour.
talking_point_generation.repair_decline: Repair category is experiencing declining sales momentum and should be reviewed for lost demand opportunities.
talking_point_generation.multiple_category_decline: Multiple aftersales categories are showing deterioration, suggesting a broader dealer performance issue.
talking_point_generation.single_category_decline: Decline appears isolated to a specific category and may indicate a focused opportunity area.
talking_point_generation.stable_performance: Dealer does not exhibit significant sustained category decline patterns.

llm_instructions: Treat Categories_With_Decline_Pct as the primary driver of insights.
Always prioritize categories with the highest average decline percentage.
Identify which categories have declined in multiple periods.
Use category sales values as supporting evidence.
Differentiate between isolated category decline and broad-based decline.
If no categories appear in Categories_With_Decline_Pct, describe dealer performance as stable.
Quantify decline percentages in generated insights.
Support every insight using actual values from the dataset.
Do not invent business reasons, market forces, customer behaviour, inventory issues, pricing issues, supply chain constraints, or operational causes.
Identify category-specific discussion points for field sales representatives.
Use actual category names in narrative output.
Prioritize latest month performance while validating trend consistency across all reporting months.
